reason: Provides configurable path-based and global rule injection into DeepSeek Harness model context, including project rule discovery, deduplication, and byte limits; it does not execute rule content.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于文件路径和全局规则的模型上下文注入，并支持项目规则发现、去重和大小限制。
summaries.en: Adds path-based and global rule injection to the DeepSeek Harness model context with project rule discovery, deduplication, and size limits.

capabilities: Reads configured rule files and project rule directories
Matches file paths against rule globs
Injects rule text into the model context through DSH lifecycle hooks
